scenarios.description: Hold Up 150 frames from standing, release for 150

scenarios.description: Hold Down 150 frames (crouch, state 4), release for 150

scenarios.description: Hold Up 70, then Right 40, then no input 120: lead reset by the walk callback

scenarios.description: Up 20; Up+Button1 3; Up 60; release everything for 90: states $15 charge -> $1A run, speed from $46E2

scenarios.name: peel_out_hold_right

scenarios.description: Up 10; Up+Button1 3; Up held 1900 frames; release; 60 frames (the state $15 script loops 210 x 8 updates before FF 01 $82CC); object slot types per frame
